task.title: Deki workspace app-data approvals, live activity, and hardening
task.source: GitHub issues #676, #677, #678 (Deki CLI-style assistant handoff Slices 3-5)
task.classification: cross-boundary Rust capability, hostable HTTP route, shared API, and Deki shell UI change

coreClaim: Deki-senpai can propose creative-library inserts, patches, and deletes only as dry-runs; nothing is written until the user approves in the Deki surface, approval re-checks current data and refuses stale previews, and the user sees Deki's steps live and can stop a run.

inScope: deki_data read and dry-run mutation command family over the creative library
Owner- and session-scoped pending approvals, approve/reject, expiry, and history
Live workspace events over a Tauri channel and a hostable SSE route
Bounded persisted trace and approval outcomes on Deki messages
Approval cards, live activity panel, and trace disclosure in the Deki shell
Docs, AGENTS.md Deki map, and discovery metadata
outOfScope: Chats, messages, memories, connections, or settings as deki_data collections
Migrating chat-access grants onto the workspace approval runtime

verification: cargo test --lib -- deki http_server http_dispatch: 295 passed
pnpm vitest run src/features/shell/deki src/shared/api/deki-api src/engine/deki: 88 passed
pnpm check: passed (unused-code report warning-only, no new entries)

End-to-end browser run: real de-koi-server with an isolated data dir and Basic Auth, scripted OpenAI-compatible model, Vite UI driven by Playwright; approve rewrote the stored lorebook entry, reject left the duplicate entry, outcomes persisted after reload, zero page errors
manualBlockers: Not exercised against a live provider model; the scripted model proves runtime, storage, streaming, and UI wiring, not live-model command choice quality
